Bribery Scandal Rocks Telangana's Irrigation Department

A panchayat secretary and an irrigation AEE have been caught taking bribes in separate incidents, highlighting corruption within the Telangana government. The cases involve large sums of money, with one bribe amounting to ₹25,000 and another to ₹2 lakh. These incidents raise concerns about the effectiveness of anti-corruption measures in the state.
